title: An Act to Authorize General Fund Bond Issues to Support Maine's Agricultural and Forestry Sectors (TITLE CHANGE) (BOND ISSUE)

summary.text: The funds provided by the bond issue, in the amount of $40,000,000, will be used to support the agricultural and forestry sectors in the State.
